description: PAID ($0.001 USDC via x402, paid automatically). Live exchange rates and a conversion: how many units of each target currency one unit of `from` buys (a live mid rate), the converted amount, and — where the European Central Bank publishes one — its daily reference rate and the deviation between the two, an independent check in the same answer. ~170 fiat currencies plus BTC, ETH and other majors. Defaults to USD against EUR, GBP, JPY, CNY, CHF, CAD, AUD, INR. An unknown currency answers 404 and is not charged. Rates for information, not an executable quote. Any answer the tool cannot produce is >= 400 and is NOT charged.

amount.description: Amount of the FROM currency to convert (default 1)

from.description: Currency to convert FROM (ISO code like USD, EUR, or a crypto like BTC), default USD

payment.description: Base64 of a single x402 v2 PaymentPayload you signed yourself. OPTIONAL: with AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY set, this tool pays automatically and you never need it. Use it to pay from a DIFFERENT wallet, or when no key is configured — call once without it to get the 402 (its body carries `howToPay.payloadTemplate`, the exact envelope to sign), then call again with it. When set it is sent as-is as the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header; no local signing and no price ceiling are applied.

to.description: Currencies to convert TO, up to 20 (default EUR,GBP,JPY,CNY,CHF,CAD,AUD,INR)

name: fx_rates

asOf.description: ISO time the live rates were read

ecbDate.description: Date of the ECB reference fixing used for ecbRate, or null

note.description: How to read a rate, and its limits

title: FX rates + conversion (live, with the ECB rate beside it) ($0.001)
